source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the universal imperative and repeated divine-source claim without adding exceptions.
key_decisions.before: Let every person be subject to the governing authorities, because there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist have been put in place by God.
key_decisions.after: Let every person submit to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let every soul be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been appointed by God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Paul's stated contrast and direct question without harmonizing it to every regime.
key_decisions.before: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct but to bad. Do you want to have no fear of the authority? Do what is good, and you will receive praise from it,
key_decisions.after: For rulers are not a cause of fear for good conduct but for bad. Do you want to have no fear of the authority? Do what is good, and you will receive its praise,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to have no fear of the authority? Do what is good, and you will have praise from it;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps servant repetition, sword, vengeance, and real coercive harm.
key_decisions.before: because it is God’s servant for your good. But if you do evil, be afraid, because it does not carry the sword for nothing. It is God’s servant, an agent of wrath against the one who practices evil.
key_decisions.after: for it is God's servant for your good. But if you do what is bad, be afraid, for it does not carry the sword for nothing. It is God's servant, an avenger who brings wrath on the one who practices evil.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for it is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do what is evil, be afraid; for it does not bear the sword in vain, for it is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath upon the one who practices evil.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains both motivations without expanding their scope.
key_decisions.before: Therefore it is necessary to be subject, not only because of wrath but also because of conscience.
key_decisions.after: Therefore, it is necessary to submit, not only because of wrath but also because of conscience.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore it is necessary to be subject, not only because of wrath but also because of conscience.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the four repeated obligation pairs.
key_decisions.before: Give everyone what is owed: tax to whom tax is owed, revenue to whom revenue, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.
key_decisions.after: Pay everyone what is owed: tax to whom tax is due, revenue to whom revenue, respect to whom respect, honor to whom honor.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Render to all what is owed: tax to whom tax is due, revenue to whom revenue, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the night/day movement and military clothing image.
key_decisions.before: The night is nearly over, and the day has drawn near. So let us lay aside the works of darkness and put on the weapons of light.
key_decisions.after: The night is nearly over, and the day has drawn near. So let us cast off the works of darkness and put on the weapons of light.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The night is far gone, and the day has drawn near. Therefore let us cast off the works of darkness and put on the armor of light.
